tables.name: spare_requests
columns: spare_request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
tracking_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(tracking_sequence BETWEEN 1 AND 99999999)
tracking_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(tracking_id)=12 AND substr(tracking_id,1,4)='SPR-' AND substr(tracking_id,5) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*')
service_request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES service_requests(service_request_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
requester_contact_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES contacts(contact_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
requester_context_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(requester_context_json))
creation_origin TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(creation_origin IN ('soma_draft','external_registration'))
created_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(created_at_utc>=0)
created_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: tracking identity immutable/non-reusable
all current/requested Customer context derives through one Service Request
requester_contact_id is a reusable LLD-02 Contact relationship recorded at request creation and is distinct from receiver_contact_id

requester_context_json uses closed REQUESTER_CONTEXT_V1 and freezes only bounded requester evidence effective at creation: contact_id, contact revision, current affiliation id/customer_org_id when any, and bounded display-name snapshot; no email/channel body is copied
requester relationship/context are retained for terminal history and are not rewritten by later Contact affiliation/descriptive changes
external registration creates same normal entity/temporary tracking identity

tables.name: spare_request_need_allocations
columns: request_need_allocation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
spare_request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES spare_requests(spare_request_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
spare_need_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES spare_needs(spare_need_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000)
revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0)
active_draft INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(active_draft IN (0,1))
created_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
last_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: service proves every selected Need belongs to request.service_request_id
one active draft allocation per request+Need
editable only while current request semantics are Draft; historical submitted quantities live in submission snapshot rows

tables.name: spare_request_draft_logistics
columns: spare_request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES spare_requests(spare_request_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(mode IN ('delivery','self_pickup'))
receiver_contact_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES contacts(contact_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
dispatch_location_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES dispatch_locations(dispatch_location_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0)
last_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: current editable logistics intent only; no historical snapshot authority
receiver is a logistics role independent from the immutable requester role and may reference the same or a different active Contact
receiver/location eligibility revalidated at submission
false-submission correction may restore Draft and permit this row to change without editing requester evidence or historical submission snapshots

tables.name: spare_request_lifecycle_events
columns: request_event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
spare_request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES spare_requests(spare_request_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
event_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(event_kind IN ('created','submission_accepted','submission_corrected_false','cancelled','rejected','acknowledgement_accepted','authorization_progress','correction'))
effective_at_utc INTEGER NULL CHECK(effective_at_utc IS NULL OR effective_at_utc>=0)
target_event_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES spare_request_lifecycle_events(request_event_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
reason_code TEXT NULL
evidence_kind TEXT NULL
evidence_id TEXT NULL
recorded_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(recorded_at_utc>=0)
command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: append-only
generated MSG is not a lifecycle event
submission_corrected_false targets an accepted submission event and can restore draft semantics only when no real send occurred

tables.name: spare_request_identifier_events
columns: identifier_event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
spare_request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES spare_requests(spare_request_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
event_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(event_kind IN ('assign','correct'))
prior_sr7 TEXT NULL
new_sr7 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(new_sr7)=9 AND substr(new_sr7,1,2)='SR' AND substr(new_sr7,3) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*')
reason_code TEXT NULL
recorded_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(recorded_at_utc>=0)
command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: append-only
assign requires prior null; correction preserves prior value through alias table
identifier does not replace spare_request_id/tracking_id

tables.name: spare_request_identifier_aliases
columns: alias_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
spare_request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES spare_requests(spare_request_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
sr7 TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(sr7)=9 AND substr(sr7,1,2)='SR' AND substr(sr7,3) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*')
alias_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(alias_kind IN ('current','former'))
source_identifier_event_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES spare_request_identifier_events(identifier_event_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: one current alias per request via partial unique index
all SR7 values globally non-reusable even after correction
former alias remains trackable historical evidence

tables.name: spare_request_submission_snapshots
columns: submission_snapshot_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
spare_request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES spare_requests(spare_request_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
submission_event_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES spare_request_lifecycle_events(request_event_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
temporary_tracking_id TEXT NOT NULL
mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(mode IN ('delivery','self_pickup'))
receiver_contact_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES contacts(contact_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
dispatch_location_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES dispatch_locations(dispatch_location_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
location_name_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL
location_address_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL
recipient_context_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(recipient_context_json))
effective_submission_at_utc INTEGER NULL CHECK(effective_submission_at_utc IS NULL OR effective_submission_at_utc>=0)
recorded_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(recorded_at_utc>=0)
evidence_kind TEXT NULL
evidence_id TEXT NULL
snapshot_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(snapshot_hash)=64)
rules: immutable per accepted submission event

multiple historical snapshots for one request are allowed only when an earlier accepted submission was explicitly corrected false; current-effective submission is derived from lifecycle correction chain
temporary_tracking_id must equal request tracking identity at acceptance
recipient_context_json uses closed SUBMISSION_RECIPIENT_V1 allowlist and never stores unrestricted Contact object
submission recipient evidence never replaces or rewrites request-level requester evidence

tables.name: spare_request_submission_allocations
columns: submission_allocation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
submission_snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES spare_request_submission_snapshots(submission_snapshot_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
request_need_allocation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES spare_request_need_allocations(request_need_allocation_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
spare_need_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES spare_needs(spare_need_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000)
requested_bom_code TEXT NOT NULL
requested_bom_key TEXT NOT NULL
rules: immutable submitted membership/quantity/BOM evidence
service validates allocation/Need/request chain exactly at acceptance
later Need/request correction does not rewrite submitted rows

tables.name: spare_request_current_projection
columns: spare_request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES spare_requests(spare_request_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
lifecycle_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(lifecycle_state IN ('draft','submitted_awaiting_response','acknowledged','partially_authorized','authorized','cancelled','rejected'))
current_sr7 TEXT NULL CHECK(current_sr7 IS NULL OR (length(current_sr7)=9 AND substr(current_sr7,1,2)='SR'))
current_submission_snapshot_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES spare_request_submission_snapshots(submission_snapshot_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
submitted_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(submitted_quantity>=0)
authorized_rma_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(authorized_rma_count>=0)
response_warning_start_utc INTEGER NULL CHECK(response_warning_start_utc IS NULL OR response_warning_start_utc>=0)
revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0)
input_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(input_fingerprint)=64)
last_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: rebuildable from identifier/submission-correction/lifecycle/RMA facts
current_submission_snapshot_id is null when no current-effective accepted submission exists
response warning starts only on accepted submission chronology, never MSG generation
partial authorization remains valid progress

submission_rule: Every accepted submission attempt gets its own immutable snapshot. A false-submission correction may return current semantics to Draft without deleting the corrected snapshot; a later real submission receives a new submission event/snapshot. Requester authority is independent of submission/receiver logistics.
